item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.103
item.description:
Release v1.0.103 fixes session, sandbox, and model-default handling, and improves response copying, reconnect behavior, and MCP/worktree reuse. It also updates remote launch flags and several tool-call edge cases.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: github: Gemini 4 Argon in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
Gemini 4 Argon is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says it is intended for complex coding, agentic, and reasoning tasks.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Gemini 3.8 Flash is now available in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
GitHub Copilot now supports Gemini 3.8 Flash, Google’s latest Flash model. GitHub says early testing showed strong performance on complex terminal-based coding tasks.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Gemini 3.7 Flash is now available in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
GitHub Copilot is rolling out Gemini 3.7 Flash, Google’s latest Flash model. GitHub says early testing showed improvements in web and app development and agentic tasks.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Gemini 2.5 Pro and Gemini 3 Flash deprecated
item.description:
GitHub has deprecated Gemini 2.5 Pro and Gemini 3 Flash across all Copilot experiences as of July 31, 2026. This includes Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions.

  • Source: GitHub
